run_gripper_server: run the gripper server launcher on a specified IP and port using Hydra config
run_gripper_client: run a gripper client after forking and waiting for the server to be available
launch_gripper_main: launch the gripper server and optionally fork a client process via the main entry point
check_server_exists: check if a gRPC server is running on a given IP and port before proceeding
instantiate_gripper_client: instantiate a gripper client from Hydra config and run it after server is ready
